newsitem.title: USA: Insignia Systems wins software contracts.
newsitem.headline: Insignia Systems wins software contracts.

text.p: Insignia Systems Inc said Tuesday that seven major point-of-sale vendors have contracted to integrate the company's newest sign, label and poster software product, Stylus Select, into their computer applications.
Point-of-Sale vendors focus on the software and systems that control cash registers and scanners at the checkout lanes of retail stores, Insignia said.
Finanacial terms of the contracts were not announced.
Insignia Systems is a designer and marketer of software used to make signs and labels.
Its shares were unchanged Tuesday at 3-1/2.
